_readme: MargBooks ki wo settings jinke bina kuch test chal hi nahi sakte.
Ye file JAAN-BOOJH KAR JSON hai, code nahi. Naya field jodne ke liye
yahan ek entry likh do -- Python chhune ki zaroorat nahi. Tester khud
jod sakta hai, aur agla update use mitayega nahi.
aliases: tester jo bhi likh sakta hai. 'discount one', 'disc 1',
'discount1' -- teeno se wahi setting milni chahiye.
labels: screen par jo LIKHA dikhta hai. Yahi se setting pehchani jati hai.
affects: ise band karne se kya badal jayega -- report me yahi dikhta hai.

configurations.name: mode_of_payment
labels: Mode of Payment required in Sale
configurations.affects: A payment window opens when a sale bill is saved

configurations.name: ask_party_retail
configurations.affects: Whether the counter sale screen asks for a party

configurations.name: ask_bill_discount
configurations.affects: Whether the Bill Discount field is shown

configurations.name: ask_item_discount
labels: Ask Item Discount on Start Sale
configurations.affects: Whether the item-wise Discount 1 column is shown

configurations.name: second_discount
configurations.affects: Whether the second discount column (Discount 2) is shown

configurations.name: calculation_type
configurations.affects: Whether GST is added on top of the price or already included in it

configurations.name: negative_stock
configurations.affects: Whether you can sell more than the stock you have

configurations.name: batch_required
configurations.affects: Whether the item grid has a Batch column

configurations.name: expiry_required
configurations.affects: Whether the item grid has an Expiry column

configurations.name: mrp_required
configurations.affects: Whether the item grid has an MRP column

configurations.name: barcode_required
configurations.affects: Whether the item grid has a Barcode column

configurations.name: patient_doctor_mandatory
configurations.affects: Whether Patient and Doctor must be filled in

configurations.name: mr_mandatory
configurations.affects: Whether MR must be filled in

configurations.name: cursor_wait_item
configurations.affects: Where the cursor stops in the item grid

configurations.name: cursor_additional_ledger
labels: Cursor wait on Additional Ledgers in Billing
configurations.affects: Whether the cursor stops on Freight / Other Head
